ORTHOGRAPHIC VERTICAL OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW. Camera directly above, looking straight down at the object's TOP SURFACE ONLY. Rectangular edges run horizontally and vertically on the canvas. Show no vertical front or side faces.

Create an ORIGINAL game sprite part for the D'thorga combine harvester: its corn header, the wide row-crop front that is mounted across the front of the combine and picks the cobs from standing corn. Draw ONLY the grain front, alone on a plain pure white background, nothing else on the canvas. Very wide, shallow canvas, three times as wide as it is tall. The front lies across the canvas from left to right and fills almost its whole width, centred; the cutting edge faces the TOP of the canvas, the side that joins the combine faces the BOTTOM.

No reel.

No combine, no cab, no wheels, no crop, grain, straw or field, no people, no animals, no dust, mud or damage, no text, letters, numbers, logos, dials, screens or lamps. No floor, ground, shadow outside the object, perspective, tilt or visible side faces. Top surfaces only.
